Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1073
Claimant:
Adam Smith
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
24 Feb 2023
Claim opened after a sideswipe during a lane change. The insured's vehicle was struck on the driver's side while
merging, and the claimant reports a wrist fratcure from the impact. The claimant is not represented by an attorney.
2 Mar 2023
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it, so coverage for this vehicle and driver is in place.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
30 Mar 2023
Police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Photos
from the scene match the account given by the other driver.
1 May 2023
Spoke with the claimant, who described the lane change and impact the same way as in the initial report. The
account has stayed consistent across every conversation so far.
31 May 2023
Vehicle damage is mostly in line with the described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is on record, and the
repair estimate has been sent to the body shop for review.
12 Jun 2023
Medical records show the wrist fracture was treated along a typical course, with follow-up visits tapering off as the
claimant improved. Whether the fracture was caused by this crash is still unclear and needs further medical review.
21 Jun 2023
Claimant mentioned a minor strain in the same area years ago, which healed completely according to the prior
records requested. Noted for the medical review, with no current evidence it affects this claim.
23 Jul 2023
Witness statements, photos and the other driver's account all confirm the accident happened as described. Liability
review is underway based on these sources.
22 Aug 2023
File is pending the medical causation review and the final repair figures. Will reassess once the treating provider's
report is received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
